label: A continuation piece inside a tokenizer-split regional place name (river, department, county, province, town) in English prose, usually the second piece, with a strong lexical skew to French/British geography: Lo|ire far above all else, then T|ynes|ide/Ty|ne, B|ante|ay Meanchey, Aberde|ens|hire, Alic|ante; single-token places in the same frames sit at roughly 0.1-0.3, and split person/company/fictional names or the same pieces inside common nouns are near zero.

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit

notes: Probes (fraction of max 6.66): Loire 0.926 ('ire'); Alicante 0.313 ('ante'); Shropshire 0.23 ('rop'); Mandalay 0.214 (' Mandal'); Oaxaca 0.137; Dubrovnik 0.132 (' Dub'); Wollongong 0.095; Eire 0.065 (' E'). Same pieces outside places: grimoire 0.03, vigilante 0.012, Infante 0.076. Split non-place names: Dostoevsky 0.022, Novartis 0.043, Narnia 0.011. Floors 0.012-0.03. Single-token places: Cambridge/Durham/Kent/Hampshire 0.13; Lyon in a 'capital of its department' frame 0.295 (hot near miss; that frame is avoided). Corpus top beyond Loire/Loir (1.0, 0.80, 0.79): Tyneside 0.74 x2, Tyne 0.74, Banteay 0.68 x2, Aberdeenshire 0.61; all but Loire sat in regionally primed text (Newcastle, Wallsend/Durham, Kbal Spean, Grampian/Dee), so unprobed fire names get one regional cue before them, matched in the near misses (Leeds, Glasgow, French, Royal Cornwall Show, India's). Reading: place recognition gated on a split name (single-token Kent/Hampshire do not fire), heavily lexical; bare pieces are not the trigger (E|ire 0.065 vs Lo|ire 0.926; vigil|ante 0.012); the peak can be the first piece (Mandal, Dub, E). Caveats: diffuse (0.2% of tokens >0.1 max; off-pattern ' have', 發生, 在 at 0.66-0.68, so ' have' is kept out of the fire set); only Loire and Alicante are probe-verified configurations; within-class generalization is weak (Oaxaca, Dubrovnik, Wollongong, Eire <0.14), so the unprobed single-letter-head Dordogne was dropped for a second Loire frame. All triggers tokenizer-verified mid-sentence; no sentence-initial capitalized split in either set. + pole unrelated: Chinese modal 会/會 (max 24.25, 100% +x+).
